headline: Spatially conditioned models localize gene co-expression and ligand-receptor interactions
label: Localized Spatially Conditioned Inference
summary: Recent preprints and papers extend localized, spatially conditioned statistics to transcriptomic and multiplexed imaging data.
synthesis: The dominant thread across these items is inference conditioned on local spatial or single-cell structure rather than global summaries. STcompare compares spatial correlation and spatial fold-change across structurally matched tissue locations, and spMOCA estimates gene co-expression networks while explicitly modeling spatial dependencies. LARIS infers cell type-specific, spatially restricted ligand-receptor interactions. DiCoLo detects localized differential co-expression without clustering or alignment, using optimal transport gene graphs. ArcFISH applies axis-specific XYZ measurement error modeling to detect A/B compartments, TADs and chromatin loops from multiplexed DNA FISH. What is new is the localized, spatially conditioned formulation applied across these problems. The planarian scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq regulatory network study, the compressed sensing imaging mass cytometry work, CLEAR-AF autofluorescence subtraction, and the generative diffeomorphic mapping of neuroanatomy address adjacent measurement and alignment needs rather than the same statistical problem.
